meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_ae5Ul3Z3m6l3Xraun_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Configuration:
    title: Configuration
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initializes configuration variables including time range, search limits, pagination state, and result storage.
    on-success:
    - Prepare_Search_Values: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Days_to_Correlate
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Correlation_Configuration.Days_to_Correlate
    - name: Maximum_Records_to_Search
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Correlation_Configuration.Maximum_Records_to_Search
    - name: Record_Search_Offset
      value: 0
    - name: Record_Search_Page
      value: 0
    - name: Record_Search_Has_Next_Page
      value: true
    - name: CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against
      value: []
    - name: Maximum_Records_to_Search_Limit
      value: 5000
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 85ff82e4-bf59-44f5-8ffc-9825413872c9
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 604cee62-9ac5-4ef6-a49b-e7b22f3249fe
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Prepare_Search_Values:
    title: Prepare Search Values
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Calculates the timestamp for the search query and validates the maximum records limit against system constraints.
    on-success:
    - While_CASE_Records_to_Retrieve: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      timestamp:
        title: Timestamp
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: $fromMillis($toMillis($now()) - variables.Days_to_Correlate * 86400000)
          data:
            variables:
              Days_to_Correlate:
                $:ref: $variables.Days_to_Correlate
        actionType: jsonata
        next: max_records_to_search
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      max_records_to_search:
        title: Max Records to Search
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            variables.Maximum_Records_to_Search <= variables.Maximum_Records_to_Search_Limit 

            ? variables.Maximum_Records_to_Search

            : variables.Maximum_Records_to_Search_Limit
          data:
            variables:
              Maximum_Records_to_Search:
                $:ref: $variables.Maximum_Records_to_Search
              Maximum_Records_to_Search_Limit:
                $:ref: $variables.Maximum_Records_to_Search_Limit
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: timestamp
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  While_CASE_Records_to_Retrieve:
    meta: {}
    title: While CASE Records to Retrieve
    type: loop
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Loops while there are more records to retrieve and the offset hasn't reached the configured maximum search limit.
    actions:
      Transform_Variables:
        meta: {}
        title: Transform Variables
        type: transformation
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success:
        - Update_Variables: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Calculates updated pagination values (offset, page number) and appends newly retrieved records to the collection.
        transformations:
          offset:
            title: Offset
            inputs:
              data:
                variables:
                  Record_Search_Offset:
                    $:ref: $variables.Record_Search_Offset
              expression: variables.Record_Search_Offset + 1000
            next: page
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            actionType: jsonata
          page:
            title: Page
            inputs:
              data:
                variables:
                  Record_Search_Page:
                    $:ref: $variables.Record_Search_Page
              expression: variables.Record_Search_Page + 1
            next: records
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            actionType: jsonata
          records:
            title: Records
            inputs:
              data:
                variables:
                  CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against:
                    $:ref: $variables.CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against
                actions:
                  Search_1000_Case_Records:
                    result:
                      records:
                        $:ref: $actions.Search_1000_Case_Records.result.records
              expression: $append(variables.CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against,actions.Search_1000_Case_Records.result.records)
            next: ""
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: append
                inputs:
                - $:ref: $variables.CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against
                - $:ref: $actions.Search_1000_Case_Records.result.records
              advancedView: false
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            actionType: jsonata
        entrypoint: offset
      Update_Variables:
        meta: {}
        title: Update Variables
        type: updateVariables
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Updates pagination tracking variables and the aggregated SIG records list with the latest search results.
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 519fdb50-f0a1-4e12-a1f4-2d04b4b97dfc
        outputSchemaReferenceId: d05cca8c-2621-480e-97bb-369e69aa62e0
        inputs:
        - name: Record_Search_Offset
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Transform_Variables.result.offset
        - name: Record_Search_Page
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Transform_Variables.result.page
        - name: Record_Search_Has_Next_Page
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Search_1000_Case_Records.result.hasNextPage
        - name: CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Transform_Variables.result.records
      Search_1000_Case_Records:
        meta: {}
        title: Search 1000 Case Records
        type: recordAction
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success:
        - Transform_Variables: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        inputs:
          applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
          limit: 1000
          returnFields:
          - tracking-id
          - signal-name
          - signal-type
          - signal-description
          - signal-source
          - mitre-attack-techniques
          - signal-impacted-users
          - signal-impacted-assets
          - signal-impacted-ip-addresses
          - alert-name
          - alert-description
          - alert-categories
          - alert-rules
          - phishing-email-subject
          - phishing-email-from
          - phishing-email-to-addresses
          - phishing-email-cc-addresses
          - phishing-email-reply-to-addresses
          - observables
          - phishing-email-text-body
          - organization
          filters:
          - fieldId: ayizq
            filterType: greaterThanOrEqual
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Values.result.timestamp
          filterType: AND
          pageNumber:
            $:ref: $variables.Record_Search_Page
          applicationName: ""
        recordActionType: search
    entrypoints:
    - Search_1000_Case_Records
    loop:
      type: while
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $variables.Record_Search_Offset
          - $:lt:
              $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Values.result.max_records_to_search
        - - $:ref: $variables.Record_Search_Has_Next_Page
          - $:eq: true
      delay: 0
      duration: 0
      limit: 10
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Configuration
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against:
    $:ref: $variables.CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against
environment: {}
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: a0b6e714-5e2b-4275-8590-abe260f69323
outputSchemaReferenceId: 9f79c5c7-7621-4b1b-be26-4a17e546b20a
inputs:
  type: object
publishSchemaReferenceId: 9752c66b-4f65-4802-8944-2107923dac71
